notes: The department page for applicants (artsci Chemistry 'Graduate Application') is used because it is the current how-to-apply page. The older degree-finder page (usu.edu/degrees-majors/chemistry_ms_phd) says a 40th-percentile GRE and 'no application deadlines' with March 15 encouraged; that conflicts with the newer page, which is used here. The Biochemistry PhD (usu.edu/degrees-majors/biochemistry_ms_phd) is admitted through the same department; its page gives a February 15 fall deadline and TOEFL 79 / IELTS 6.5, and it is covered by this record's rules. Department review is by the Graduate Program Coordinator; a research advisor letter is requested if applicable.
